**IDENTITY:**
  KIND: package body
  PURPOSE: outbound/inbound integration with external systems — GL journal export, benefits feed export, time & attendance import, org structure sync, and integration status lookup

**STRUCTURES:**
  c_gl_output_dir — KIND: constant; TYPE: VARCHAR2(30)
  c_benefits_output_dir — KIND: constant; TYPE: VARCHAR2(30)
  c_time_input_dir — KIND: constant; TYPE: VARCHAR2(30)

**METHODS:**
  **PROCEDURE generate_gl_journal(p_run_id IN NUMBER, p_user IN VARCHAR2 DEFAULT USER)** [SOURCE: L16-83]
  - What it does: Builds a GL journal flat file for a payroll run. Opens a file in directory GL_FEED_OUT named `GL_JOURNAL_<p_run_id>_<YYYYMMDD>.dat`, writes a header record `H|HRMS_PAYROLL|<YYYY-MM-DD>|<run_id>`, then loops over PAYROLL_DETAILS/PAYROLL_RUNS/PAY_PERIODS/EMPLOYEES/DEPARTMENTS/PAY_ELEMENTS joined and grouped by cost center, GL account code, element type, and period name, writing one detail line per group, then a trailer record `T|<count>` and closes the file.
  - Business rules: Rows with PAYROLL_DETAILS.STATUS = 'ERROR' are excluded [L47]. Rows where PAY_ELEMENTS.GL_ACCOUNT_CODE IS NULL are excluded [L48]. If ELEMENT_TYPE = 'EARNING', the amount is posted as a debit to the expense account (debit column = amount, credit column = 0.00) [L54-58]; otherwise (deductions/taxes) it is posted as a credit to a liability account (debit column = 0.00, credit column = amount) [L59-63].
  - Numbers & thresholds: v_filename sized VARCHAR2(100); UTL_FILE.FOPEN max line size 32767; amount format mask `FM999999990.00` (fixed 2 decimal places, no thousands separator); v_entries counter starts at 0.
  - Security & error handling: No access control beyond OS-level directory-object permissions; file writes use UTL_FILE. On WHEN OTHERS: closes the file if still open, logs the error via PKG_COMMON.log_error, then RAISEs (propagates the exception).
  - Data in/out: Inputs — p_run_id (NUMBER, required), p_user (VARCHAR2, defaults to session USER). Output/side effect — writes a pipe-delimited flat file to the GL_FEED_OUT directory; logs an info message with the entry count and filename.

  **PROCEDURE export_benefits_feed(p_effective_date IN DATE DEFAULT SYSDATE, p_user IN VARCHAR2 DEFAULT USER)** [SOURCE: L90-147]
  - What it does: Builds a fixed-width ADP-format benefits enrollment file. Opens a file in directory BENEFITS_FEED_OUT named `BENEFITS_<YYYYMMDD>.txt`, loops over EMPLOYEES left-joined to EMPLOYEE_DEPENDENTS, and writes one fixed-width line per employee/dependent row, then closes the file. Note: p_effective_date is accepted as a parameter but the query itself filters only on employment status, not on this date.
  - Business rules: Only employees with EMPLOYMENT_STATUS = 'ACTIVE' are included [L115]. Only dependents with ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y' are included (via the LEFT JOIN condition) [L114]. Output ordered by EMP_NUMBER, then DEPENDENT_ID [L116].
  - Numbers & thresholds: v_filename sized VARCHAR2(100); UTL_FILE.FOPEN max line size 32767; fixed-width field widths (via RPAD): EMP_NUMBER 10, FIRST_NAME 30, LAST_NAME 30, DATE_OF_BIRTH 10, HIRE_DATE 10, EMPLOYMENT_STATUS 12, MARITAL_STATUS 10, GENDER 1, DEP_FIRST_NAME 30, DEP_LAST_NAME 30, RELATIONSHIP 20, DEP_DOB 10.
  - Security & error handling: No access control beyond directory-object permissions. On WHEN OTHERS: closes the file if open, logs the error via PKG_COMMON.log_error, then RAISEs.
  - Data in/out: Inputs — p_effective_date (DATE, defaults to SYSDATE, currently unused in the query), p_user (VARCHAR2, defaults to session USER). Output/side effect — writes a fixed-width flat file to BENEFITS_FEED_OUT; logs an info message with record count and filename.

  **PROCEDURE import_time_attendance(p_file_name IN VARCHAR2, p_user IN VARCHAR2 DEFAULT USER)** [SOURCE: L153-194]
  - What it does: Opens p_file_name for read from directory TIME_ATTENDANCE_IN and loops line by line via UTL_FILE.GET_LINE. Skips blank lines and lines starting with `#` (comments) [L168]; for any other line it only increments the imported counter — the CSV parsing (emp_number,date,hours_regular,hours_overtime) and the actual payroll/database update are marked `TODO: Implement actual parsing and database update` [L170] and are not implemented. Exits the loop on NO_DATA_FOUND (end of file), closes the file, and logs the imported/error counts.
  - Business rules: Blank lines and lines beginning with `#` are treated as non-data and skipped [L168]. No other validation or persistence is performed — this is effectively a stub that counts lines without writing any data.
  - Numbers & thresholds: UTL_FILE.FOPEN max line size 32767; v_line sized VARCHAR2(4000); v_imported and v_errors counters start at 0.
  - Security & error handling: Per-line errors are caught inside the loop (WHEN OTHERS increments v_errors and logs via PKG_COMMON.log_error) without aborting the loop; NO_DATA_FOUND exits the loop normally. Outer WHEN OTHERS closes the file if open, logs the error via PKG_COMMON.log_error, then RAISEs.
  - Data in/out: Inputs — p_file_name (VARCHAR2, required, name of file in TIME_ATTENDANCE_IN), p_user (VARCHAR2, defaults to session USER). Output/side effect — none to the database (parsing/update not implemented); logs an info message with imported/error counts.

  **PROCEDURE sync_org_structure(p_user IN VARCHAR2 DEFAULT USER)** [SOURCE: L196-203]
  - What it does: Placeholder procedure — contains no logic beyond logging completion; comment states it is intended to sync org structure with an external directory (LDAP/AD) but this is not implemented.
  - Business rules: None (unimplemented placeholder).
  - Numbers & thresholds: None.
  - Security & error handling: None — no exception handler present in this procedure.
  - Data in/out: Input — p_user (VARCHAR2, defaults to session USER). Output/side effect — logs an info message "Org structure sync completed"; no actual sync performed.

  **FUNCTION get_integration_status(p_integration_name IN VARCHAR2) RETURN VARCHAR2** [SOURCE: L205-210]
  - What it does: Looks up and returns a configuration parameter named `<p_integration_name>_STATUS` under the 'INTEGRATION' category via PKG_COMMON.get_param.
  - Business rules: None beyond the fixed parameter-name convention `<name>_STATUS`.
  - Numbers & thresholds: None.
  - Security & error handling: None — no exception handler; behavior on missing parameter depends on PKG_COMMON.get_param's own handling (not visible in this file).
  - Data in/out: Input — p_integration_name (VARCHAR2). Output — returns the parameter value as VARCHAR2.

**DEPENDENCIES:**
  Data touched:
  - Reads: PAYROLL_DETAILS — payroll line amounts/status for the run
  - Reads: PAYROLL_RUNS — links PAYROLL_DETAILS to its pay period
  - Reads: PAY_PERIODS — period name for the journal file
  - Reads: EMPLOYEES — department linkage (GL journal) and demographic/status data (benefits feed)
  - Reads: DEPARTMENTS — cost center for GL journal
  - Reads: PAY_ELEMENTS — GL account code and element type (earning vs. deduction/tax)
  - Reads: EMPLOYEE_DEPENDENTS — dependent demographic data for benefits feed
  - Reads: external CSV file (via UTL_FILE) from TIME_ATTENDANCE_IN directory, named by p_file_name
  - Writes: external flat file `GL_JOURNAL_<run_id>_<YYYYMMDD>.dat` in GL_FEED_OUT directory (not a DB table)
  - Writes: external flat file `BENEFITS_<YYYYMMDD>.txt` in BENEFITS_FEED_OUT directory (not a DB table)

  CALLS: PKG_COMMON.log_info | EVIDENCE: OBSERVED | SOURCE: L74
  CALLS: PKG_COMMON.log_error | EVIDENCE: OBSERVED | SOURCE: L81
  CALLS: PKG_COMMON.log_info | EVIDENCE: OBSERVED | SOURCE: L138
  CALLS: PKG_COMMON.log_error | EVIDENCE: OBSERVED | SOURCE: L145
  CALLS: PKG_COMMON.log_error | EVIDENCE: OBSERVED | SOURCE: L178
  CALLS: PKG_COMMON.log_info | EVIDENCE: OBSERVED | SOURCE: L185
  CALLS: PKG_COMMON.log_error | EVIDENCE: OBSERVED | SOURCE: L192
  CALLS: PKG_COMMON.log_info | EVIDENCE: OBSERVED | SOURCE: L201
  CALLS: PKG_COMMON.get_param | EVIDENCE: OBSERVED | SOURCE: L209

  Config/env: Oracle directory objects GL_FEED_OUT, BENEFITS_FEED_OUT, TIME_ATTENDANCE_IN (referenced via constants c_gl_output_dir/c_benefits_output_dir/c_time_input_dir); PKG_COMMON parameter category 'INTEGRATION' with keys `<integration_name>_STATUS`.
  External integrations: Oracle Financials batch import (consumes the pipe-delimited GL journal file, per header comment L14) [EXTERNAL]; ADP benefits enrollment system (consumes the fixed-width benefits file, per header comment L87-88) [EXTERNAL]; external time & attendance CSV source feeding TIME_ATTENDANCE_IN [EXTERNAL]; LDAP/AD directory service intended for org structure sync but not implemented [EXTERNAL, INFERRED from comment L200].

**GAPS:**
  import_time_attendance's actual CSV parsing and database update logic is an unimplemented TODO [L170] — UNRESOLVED, cannot determine target table(s) it would write to.
  sync_org_structure's intended LDAP/AD sync logic is not implemented — UNRESOLVED, cannot determine what would be read/written.
  get_integration_status: underlying storage/table behind PKG_COMMON.get_param is not visible in this file — UNKNOWN.
  Directory object physical OS paths for GL_FEED_OUT, BENEFITS_FEED_OUT, TIME_ATTENDANCE_IN are not defined in this file — EXTERNAL (defined at the Oracle DIRECTORY object / DBA level).
